items.html: And this is what is written in the Idra of Naso, page 134, side A: "Correction 8, etc., and it is taught that everything depends on the Mazal, which is that thread, etc." And likewise on the aforementioned page, regarding correction 13, it says: "And this thirteenth includes them, etc., and in it they are included in this Mazal, etc." Behold, it turns out that correction 8 and correction 13 are both called Mazalot.
